title: An improved method to prepare an injectable microemulsion of the galanin-receptor 3 selective antagonist, SNAP 37889, using Kolliphor® HS 15
author: Scheller, Williams, et al.

steps.title: Weigh and place Kolliphor HS 15
steps.instruction: Weigh 3 g Kolliphor® HS 15 and place it in the bottom of a smooth glass mortar; avoid using a porous ceramic mortar and pestle. The thick paste will later be transferred with a soft plastic spatula.

steps.title: Add SNAP 37889
steps.instruction: Weigh 300 mg SNAP 37889 and add it on top of the Kolliphor® HS 15 paste.

steps.title: Triturate mixture
steps.instruction: Triturate the components with a pestle until all visible SNAP 37889 particles are dissolved (≈2 min).

steps.title: Dilute with buffer and vortex
steps.instruction: Using a soft plastic spatula, transfer the drug paste to a suitable container, gradually add 6.7 ml room‑temperature sodium phosphate buffer to reach a final volume of 10 ml, warming the tube in your palm if needed; vortex for 1 min until the paste is fully dissolved, then let the aerated solution sit for 20 min or until most bubbles have coalesced.

substeps.instruction: If preparing a drug‑free vehicle, first mix the Kolliphor® HS 15 paste alone in the mortar and pestle to soften before adding buffer
Add 6.7 ml room‑temperature sodium phosphate buffer gradually
Let stand 20 min until bubbles coalesce

steps.title: Load syringes
steps.instruction: Load syringes with the appropriate volume of the prepared emulsion for injection (1 ml per kg body weight).

steps.title: Protect from light
steps.instruction: Wrap any transparent containers holding SNAP 37889 or Kolliphor® HS 15 in foil to exclude light, as both compounds are light‑sensitive.
